test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Workers and companies in all sectors can contribute their skills to meet society new needs.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** error is in** the part *"to meet society new needs."*
 
• The** correct phrase should be*** "to meet society's new needs."*
 
• In English, when you want to indicate that something belongs to someone or something, you use the possessive form, which is often made by adding an apostrophe and an "s" at the end of the word.
 
• Here, "society's new needs" **means** "the new needs of society."

Therefore, the** corrected sentence** would be: *"Workers and companies in all sectors can contribute their skills **to meet society's new needs."***
